note: Every member has a real, owned, commercially-motivated partner programme. Each carries an independent blocker that does not appeal to materiality, ownership, surface, distribution, size, or non-customer status.

companies.name: PartnerStack
companies.negativeRationale: PartnerStack sells partner-relationship management software. It will not buy a competing PRM.
companies.rationaleSource: partnerstack.com product pages — the company's own description of what it sells
companies.rationaleIndependence: Independent of materiality, ownership and surface: the blocker is what the company sells, not how its partner programme looks.

companies.name: Impartner

companies.rationaleSource: impartner.com product pages; Phase 2 CNAME fingerprints at nokia.com and proofpoint.com
companies.rationaleIndependence: Independent — blocker is the product category the company sells.

companies.rationaleSource: kiflo.com product pages; thesis §K.1 competitive landscape

companies.name: ZINFI
companies.negativeRationale: ZINFI sells unified partner management software; named in the Introw thesis as an enterprise competitor.

companies.name: Booking.com
companies.negativeRationale: Booking.com's 'partners' are the hotels and properties whose inventory it sells. They supply what Booking sells; they do not resell Booking's product. There is no partner-sourced pipeline into a CRM, no deal registration on Booking's own product, and no commission paid to partners for reselling it.
companies.rationaleSource: partner.booking.com — the programme's own description of who partners are and what they do
companies.rationaleIndependence: Independent of materiality, ownership and surface: the blocker is the DIRECTION of the commercial relationship, which those three constructs do not measure.
companies.featureOverlapRisk: high by design — this entry is intended to fire every positive probe

companies.name: Expedia Group
companies.negativeRationale: Partners are lodging suppliers listing inventory, not a resale channel for Expedia's product.

companies.name: Deliveroo
companies.negativeRationale: 'Restaurant partners' are merchants supplying food that Deliveroo sells and delivers. They are supply, not a channel reselling Deliveroo's product.

companies.name: Just Eat Takeaway
companies.negativeRationale: Partners are restaurants supplying inventory to the marketplace, not resellers of Just Eat's product.

companies.name: Bolt
companies.negativeRationale: 'Partners' are drivers and fleet operators supplying transport capacity. There is no product being resold and no partner-sourced B2B pipeline.
companies.rationaleSource: bolt.eu driver and fleet partner pages

companies.name: Airbnb
companies.negativeRationale: Hosts and co-hosts supply the inventory Airbnb sells. Partner language and onboarding exist; a resale channel does not.

companies.name: Uber
companies.negativeRationale: 'Partners' are drivers and merchants supplying capacity and inventory, not a channel reselling Uber's product.
companies.rationaleSource: uber.com driver and merchant partner pages
